name: RSSWire
author: Thirdy

sections.description:
Generates a simple RSS 2.0 rss.xml containing published posts with full post content. Admin UI to regenerate and shows file path/URL.

White-Label your WP RSS Feed

Two ways to install:
1. Via WordPress Plugin Directory on your site
2. Via https://wordpress.org/plugins/rsswire/

The Official Site is at https://thofficial.infree.page/index.php/rsswire/
sections.faq:
Does my WordPress blog title get auto added?

Yes, It does all the hard work for you!

Does my post get added automatically?

Yes, of course it gets added to your feed
